errors.serverStartDate: Enter a date that is not in the future.

dialog.name: Name

stateNumber.label: State number
stateNumber.hint: The state your chief lives in. Whole number.

info.label: Where to find the server start date
info.screen: Open the game and go to the Server screen from your profile.
info.date: Read the date the server opened. If it only shows the server day number, count back that many days from today.
info.missing: No date on screen? Ask your alliance leader or check state chat.
info.tolerance: A date within 21 days either way is enough. Research unlocks use 150 and 600 days, so three weeks of error rarely changes the result.

generation.label: Heroes unlocked up to
generation.hint: Heroes of later generations stay hidden on the Heroes page and in Plan.

events.hint: Hidden events leave the Core events tabs and their Event log. Turn them back on any time.

delete.title: Delete chief
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete “{name}”?
delete.note: This removes the chief and all of its levels, goals and notes from this device. There is no way to bring it back after the 10 second Undo ends.
